rappel_detail.station: From an anchor on the right edge of the highest summit overhangs.
rappel_detail.notes: Rappel 1 of 7, about 35 m on two 70 m ropes, angling left to the ledge atop pitch 10.
Rappel 2 of 7, about 30 m on two 70 m ropes, down the flake pitch.

rappel_detail.station: From the anchor below the flake pitch.
rappel_detail.notes: Rappel 3 of 7, about 40 m on two 70 m ropes, angling hard right; fixed wires are in place for directionals on the strand you will not pull.
Rappel 4 of 7, about 45 m on two 70 m ropes, into the cave.
Rappel 5 of 7, about 61 m on two 70 m ropes, a rope-stretching rappel to the ledge atop pitch 3.
hazards: This one stretches two 70 m ropes; knot the ends.

rappel_detail.notes: Rappel 6 of 7, about 45 m on two 70 m ropes, down pitch 3.

rappel_detail.station: From the anchor at the foot of pitch 3.
rappel_detail.notes: Rappel 7 of 7, about 60 m on two 70 m ropes, down and slightly right over the terrain of pitches 1 and 2.

set.rappels: 7 rappels on two 70 m ropes down the route; or scramble off down and left on a treed ramp into the 3rd-class gully, or rappel the Ellen Pea line
set.rappel_count_note: Seven rappels on two 70 m ropes, one of them a rope-stretching 61 m from the cave. A non-rappel descent tops out and scrambles down and left on a treed ramp into the 3rd-class gully left of the wall. From the base, walk left down the gully, or rappel the bolted slab below and right: about 75 m more, on three bolted anchors.
